'''Antoni Molné Oviedo'''{{fnf|Molné|Oviedo|lang=Catalan}} (born 27 April 1969) is an [[Andorra]]n judoka who competed in the [[1992 Summer Olympics]] and the [[1996 Summer Olympics]].<ref>{{cite Sports-Reference |title=Antoni Molne |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/mo/antoni-molne-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418123742/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/mo/antoni-molne-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |accessdate=26 November 2017}}</ref>

Molne entered the [[Judo at the 1992 Summer Olympics|extra lightweight]] competition at the [[1992 Summer Olympics]] and after receiving a bye in the first round he lost to the [[Italy|Italian]], [[Marino Cattefra]] in the next round.<ref>{{cite web |title=Barcelona Official Report |url=http://library.la84.org/6oic/OfficialReports/1992/1992s5.pdf |website=la84.org |accessdate=26 November 2017}}</ref> Four years later at the [[1996 Summer Olympics]] he competed in the [[Judo at the 1996 Summer Olympics – Men's 65 kg|65 kg]] weight division, again he received a bye in the first round before losing to [[Timur Mukhamedkhanov]] from [[Uzbekistan]].<ref>{{cite web |title=1996 Official Report |url=http://library.la84.org/6oic/OfficialReports/1996/1996v3.pdf |website=la84.org |accessdate=26 November 2017}}</ref>
